401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

companyId.description: Company associated with the contact. Autotask requires this company ID in the contact child-resource path.

primaryContact.description: Making this contact primary clears the previous primary contact for the company.

note.description: API-only note displayed in customized Contact Insight views.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

companyId.description: The Autotask company for this opportunity. If Contact ID is provided, the contact must be active and belong to this company or its parent.

ownerResourceId.description: An active standard Autotask resource with CRM access who owns the opportunity.

amount.description: The opportunity total amount. When revenue-period fields are supplied, Autotask recalculates this value.

cost.description: The opportunity total cost. When cost-period fields are supplied, Autotask recalculates this value.

probability.description: The close probability as a number from 0 through 100.

projectedCloseDate.description: The projected close date in YYYY-MM-DD format. It cannot be earlier than the opportunity create date.

useQuoteTotals.description: Use quote totals for this opportunity. Set true only when an Autotask quote references the opportunity.

contactId.description: An active contact associated with Company ID or that company's parent.

opportunityCategoryId.description: The opportunity category. Autotask applies the selected category's defaults when the opportunity is created.

organizationalLevelAssociationId.description: The Autotask organizational level association for the opportunity.

productId.description: The Autotask product associated with the opportunity.

nextStep.description: The next planned step for the opportunity.

barriers.description: Barriers that may prevent the opportunity from closing.

helpNeeded.description: Help needed to advance the opportunity.

market.description: The market associated with the opportunity.

promotionName.description: The promotion associated with the opportunity.

lossReasonDetail.description: Additional detail explaining why the opportunity was lost.

lostDate.description: The lost date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Supply it when the opportunity status is Lost.

winReasonDetail.description: Additional detail explaining why the opportunity was won.

closedDate.description: The closed date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

promisedFulfillmentDate.description: The promised fulfillment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

throughDate.description: The revenue through date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

revenueSpreadUnit.description: The Autotask revenue spread unit. When both spread fields are omitted, Autotask uses its all-at-once behavior.

revenueSpread.description: The revenue spread quantity. Autotask discards it when Revenue Spread Unit is omitted.

totalAmountMonths.description: The total number of months included in the opportunity amount.

onetimeCost.description: One-time cost. Billing-period cost inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Cost.

onetimeRevenue.description: One-time revenue. Billing-period revenue inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Amount.

monthlyCost.description: Monthly cost. Billing-period cost inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Cost.

monthlyRevenue.description: Monthly revenue. Billing-period revenue inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Amount.

quarterlyCost.description: Quarterly cost. Billing-period cost inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Cost.

quarterlyRevenue.description: Quarterly revenue. Billing-period revenue inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Amount.

semiannualCost.description: Semiannual cost. Billing-period cost inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Cost.

semiannualRevenue.description: Semiannual revenue. Billing-period revenue inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Amount.

yearlyCost.description: Yearly cost. Billing-period cost inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Cost.

yearlyRevenue.description: Yearly revenue. Billing-period revenue inputs cause Autotask to recalculate total Amount.

userDefinedFields[].description: Optional Autotask opportunity user-defined fields. Multi-select and reference UDFs are not supported by the REST API.

userDefinedFields[].name.description: The exact name of the Autotask user-defined field.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

opportunityId.description: Opportunity that will receive the attachment.

data.description: Base64-encoded file contents. Autotask limits individual attachments to approximately 6-7 MB.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

companyId.description: Required when creating a project; Autotask does not allow changing the company after creation.

projectType.description: Baseline projects cannot be created, updated, or deleted through the API.

startDateTime.description: Must be before the end date. Autotask ignores any time component.

endDateTime.description: Must be on or after the end date of the latest phase, task, or issue. Autotask ignores any time component.

status.description: Inactive status inactivates the project; completing a project also completes its associated tasks.

userDefinedFields[].description: Optional project user-defined fields. Multi-select and reference UDFs are not supported.
